description:
At the beginning, I must say sorry first.
I useing translator software alot, so the words will be very naive and funny.
The most important part is translate by gunnyfreak. Thank you my friend.

Second, I try a very funny way do the translator. As a mod.
The body of my mod is an ordinary mod in Chinese language. And make two other mods to do the translator(dont ask me why need two...).
So, you should download my basal mod and the language pack, then load them together.

Basal mod:
http://pan.baidu.com/share/link?shareid=501534&uk=2435520752

Language pack(out of date):
http://pan.baidu.com/share/link?shareid=501536&uk=2435520752

And here is the Mediafire supply from HELMUT:
http://www.mediafire.com/folder/gfi56meh2f2w1mn,cune6es5t8b3evs/shared

Here is translate retranslated from Helios(thank you dude):
https://www.dropbox.com/s/akn3wpw5caz5298/World%20War%20English%20Patch%20Retranslated.zip

Have fun.
